purpose: Item 1 only: systematic integer row-plus-column overlay, not a cipher/key search
transformation: Same-facing double reflection, then C[r,c] versus T[r-dy,c-dx]; positive dx right, positive dy down; no wrapping.
registration: Unchanged centered ragged 33-column rows, literal header sensitivity and MYVGT/AABCD anchor; no new row registration, crop or glyph choice.
readout: Exact A-Z identities only; fixed cipher row-major order. Preserve all source/raw/grid coordinates, glyph/stream/K4 positions and full strings for every frame. No English scoring, path extraction or reading-order search.
apertures: Unchanged 5x7 bridged surrogate. Blank/padding solid; punctuation not a label wildcard; any positive pixel AND is modeled transmission; full equal masks separate. Flat coincident equal-scale/baseline sheets, normal rays; no measured optics.
denominators: Geometric=(33-abs(dx))*(28-abs(dy)); comparable A-Z pairs separate; common/union pixel ratio descriptive; zero overlap gives zero counts and undefined ratios/no p-value.
conditioning: Fixed tableau and five original cipher anchor letters. Independently shuffle each row’s other A-Z slots or rotate its movable-letter sequence. Preserve per-row histograms, punctuation/padding and anchor coordinates.
expectations: Exact common-denominator integer means from movable row frequencies plus fixed glyph contributions. Both conditional null schemes have the same means.
statistic: (value-E)/sqrt(max(E,1)). Exact ranking via signed squared rational comparison: n=value*D-N, M=max(N,D), compare sign(n) and signed n^2/M; D common. Floating display only, no normal approximation.
selector: For every draw rescore every active dx/dy/registration. Retain the maximum for each endpoint; calibrate actual family maximum and every frame against that distribution. No overlap-fraction ranking or minimum-overlap filter.
multiplicity: Plus-one p=(exceedances+1)/2000. Multiply by four (two endpoints/two null reports), capped at 1. This covers only the frozen item-1 selector, not all historical hypotheses or eight future investigations.
display: Report top five per endpoint by frozen statistic, with denominators and all ties counted; stable tie order model order, dy ascending, dx ascending. Raw counts/fractions and matched strings descriptive only.
algorithm: Exact carry-free integer-polynomial cross-correlation with row stride 2W-1; 16-bit coefficient digits for actual label/pixel counts, 64-bit digits for scaled exact expectations. Prove coefficient bounds and compare every lag against independent cell traversal.
controls: 18 planted 5x4 overlays (two model choices times dx,dy in {-1,0,1}), truth included in complete maximum set; explicit ambiguous ties retained. Exact small-grid cross-correlations, expectations versus exhaustive row permutations/rotations, boundary/punctuation/mask controls, both reflections, fixed-anchor null invariants, full-selector seed replay. Independent JS cell-forward/pixel oracle on toys and all 7638 actual frames; row-zero counts/means match old 134 records.
stopping: No extra registrations, row/column ranges, extraction, font, thresholds, seed or sample-size retuning after scores. Timeout/incomplete is unresolved, not rejection. Do not start items 2-8.
scope_limits: Public/manual UI and prior column results already known. Protocol precedes new systematic rankings, not historically blind. Conditional coincidence excess does not specify an encryption inverse or prove physical folding/Sanborn intent.
